methods.implementation:
@Builder
private quickChoiceTrigger() {
        .value<
    >('快速选择').selected<
    >(0)
        .controlSize<
    >(ControlSize.SMALL)
        .font<
    >({ size: TYPE_DOWNLOAD_QUICK_SELECT.fontSizeFp, family: TYPE_DOWNLOAD_QUICK_SELECT.fontFamily, weight: TYPE_DOWNLOAD_QUICK_SELECT.fontWeight })
        .textModifier<
    >(this.selectTextModifier(true))
        .arrowModifier<
    >(this.selectArrowModifier(true))
        .space<
    >(this.selectArrowGap(true))
        .height<
    >(this.textControlHeight(DOWNLOAD_VISUAL.chapterQuickHeight, DOWNLOAD_VISUAL.chapterQuickLineHeight, DOWNLOAD_VISUAL.settingsSelectPadding * 2))
        .width<
    >(this.selectClosedWidth('快速选择', ['快速选择', '当前章节', '从当前往后', '全部章节'], DOWNLOAD_VISUAL.chapterToolbarSelectMaxWidth, '章节内容', true))
        .fontColor<
    >(downloadVisualColor('muted', this.appThemeScheme)).padding<
    >(DOWNLOAD_VISUAL.settingsSelectPadding)
        .backgroundColor<
    >(downloadVisualColor('soft', this.appThemeScheme)).borderRadius<
    >(DOWNLOAD_VISUAL.settingsSelectRadius)
        .constraintSize<
    >({ maxWidth: DOWNLOAD_VISUAL.chapterToolbarSelectMaxWidth })
        .hitTestBehavior<
    >(HitTestMode.None);
}
